title: Geysers!
description: Don't stand still for too long! Geysers are just waiting to launch you into the sky! (and it hurts to fall down)
body:
# Geysers! 💦

Keep moving — the ground is out to get you!

![Geyser Launch!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3935541cd0ec6d0372c4253e8420adc613717ac0.jpeg)

Stand still on solid ground and a countdown begins:

- ⏱️ **3 seconds** — the earth starts to bubble and your screen begins to rumble, building as the pressure rises.
- 🌋 **5 seconds** — a geyser erupts from right beneath your feet in a column of water and spray, and blasts you high into the sky.

Move before the timer runs out and it resets. No more standing around!

## Features

- 💦 Water-geyser eruptions triggered by standing still (also digging!)
- 📳 Escalating screen shake as the pressure builds
- 🚀 A big, satisfying launch (with a little random scatter)
- 👥 Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
- 👻 Spectators and airborne players are spared

## ⚠️ ...But be careful!

What flies too high has to fall! The launch is high enough that the landing can hurt — or kill... Pack a water bucket, a hay bale, and... Launch!

## Requirements

- Minecraft 26.1.2 (Fabric)
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
